name: a2cr
description: AI-agent handoff checkpoints and temporary work memory with local encryption before upload.
long_description: A2CR lets Claude Desktop save and load compact WorkBaton checkpoints through a local MCP server. WorkBaton content is validated and encrypted on the user's machine before it is sent to the A2CR hosted service.

tools.name: get_account_limits
tools.description: Return current A2CR account limits and quota metadata.

tools.name: list_contexts
tools.description: List WorkBaton Slot metadata without returning stored content.

tools.name: save_context
tools.description: Validate and locally encrypt compact WorkBaton handoff content before saving it to A2CR.

tools.name: load_context
tools.description: Load a WorkBaton Slot by name or number and decrypt its content locally.

a2cr_api_key.title: A2CR API Key
a2cr_api_key.description: API key for the A2CR hosted service.

a2cr_base_url.title: A2CR Base URL
a2cr_base_url.description: A2CR service URL. Keep the default unless you are testing a compatible deployment.
